I purchased this to use as an occassional visual aid when teaching groups of youth, along with a pack of the U-brand dry erase markers.

Pros:
-Very small, light and easy to carry
-No-frills design

Cons:
-Backing is cardboard and is easy to dent, warping the shape of the entire dry erase board if not handled carefully
-Holder clip does not do a good job of holding tightly to even the same-brand dry erase markers. Makes losing the markers very easy to do.
-Holder clip itself falls off very easy without warning
-Surface does not clean well. The U-brand markers do not really erase, they largely just get smeared all over the surface. Most dry erase boards require a periodic cleaning with solvent to get 100% clean, but this one seems to require that with every use. Disappointing.

Good for what it costs, but paying a bit more for a nicer one that cleans better and is more durable is likely a better way to go.

It comes with everything it says it does it came with a whiteboard marker with an eraser it came with a spot for the Whiteboard marker it came with a blue/green magnet it came with magnets to put on the back of the Whiteboard. it was super amazing and the price was super cheap I really didn't think it would be that good for such a low price. besides it was exactly the same as it shows and a easily erases. the marker was brand new and worked perfectly good.  so I would definitely recommend getting this it was super lightweight too. the whole entire whiteboard was magnetic. there wasn't one thing wrong even the shipping was fast and free.

t: Unlimited quick-figure opportunity without need to create scrap paper -- and no mess.
x:
Greatly improved over earlier era design. I expect I'll really like it.
• Nice way to erase using felt pad on pen cap. I think I'll be swapping this cap onto other erasable pens later on.
• Looks like plenty of room -- all I need and just enough to set aside a reserved note here or there.
• Should replace my need for wasting scratchpad paper.
• Doesn't seem to make a mess when erasing. Felt pad maybe can be cleaned after heavy use??

Con: Would be better if its rectangle were inset into frame rather than enclasped by one.

t: Easy to hang up, marker is good quality, Velcro hanging strips hard to get off.
x: This is great for writing little reminders and keeping track of household bills and such. It comes with four Velcro strips that stick to the surface you want to place the board. The only issue is that once the strips have been stuck in place, they are a bit difficult to get off. The board itself can detach, but the four strips will need to be replaced when we move and take the board with us. Marker works well and hasn’t run out in over five months. Board fits on the top half of our refrigerator door and isn’t very heavy or bulky. Took about five minutes to put together and hang it up.

t: The board was the perfect size to carry and still have enough room to ...
x: I was skeptical about buying this board online, but the price was right and I needed one quickly.  I was having vocal cord surgery and I was restricted from talking for 10 days. The board was the perfect size to carry and still have enough room to write on.  The attached marker even had it's own eraser head on it.  It cleaned quickly without any ghost images remaining of what was last on there. Win-win for me.

For some reason many dry erase board makers seem to think they're product is worth their weight in gold, double down on that for the magnetic ones... are you kidding me?
This has 2 magnetic strips on the back, good for a refrigerator or you can just hang it on a wall. (mounting kit not included) Works great, wipes clean with dry board eraser tip on the marker that it comes with. I use this one to remind me of chores for the day, things to pick up on my next supermarket outing, or whatever. GREAT DEAL ON THIS, similar ones in retail stores, or online as well, cost 2 - 4 times as much.
I highly recommend and would purchase again, and probably will get another one soon.
HINT: Given some of the complaints I read here.
The longer you leave the dry erase ink on the board the harder it is to remove fully, and some colors are worse about residue, in my experience using dry erase boards, green seems to be the most difficult. I have a spray bottle filled with rubbing alcohol (isopropyl) - spray it on, wipe of with a paper towel every so often keeps it looking new. AND if you use magnets with sharp edges they will scratch the board over time which will in turn make it more difficult to remove dry erase ink.
Corraling all the lists and you can port from room to room

i carry this whiteboard in my backpack for work, and it's a great visual for kids and for drawing! very easy to clean and transport. the only small complaint is that the marker can come out of the holder pretty easily, so it can be somewhat easy to lose track of.

t: I would recommend if you're in the market for a cheap dry erase board.
x: Pretty good for the price.  I would recommend cleaning it often with alcohol  to make it easy to a race the marker. I'm a realtor and I use it for open houses.  It's pretty useful and is easy to pack up and carry. It's lightweight and not to bulky. I would recommend if you're in the market for a cheap dry erase board.

t: Great simple board, but note new description: hardware is velcro, not magnets
x: Nice simple dry erase board, but the description was a bit confusing - I assumed the board attached via magnets, so you could stick it to a fridge (like the smaller one I ordered a while back from this seller/brand), but this one attaches via double-sided velcro instead. That's since been added to the description, but I was dissappointed. It's a nice-sized board and we use it all the time - it's durable, lightweight, and easy to clean.

t: Lightweight and I used Command Strips instead!
x: Perfect size for my wall sits smoothly in my test. I will not use the adhesive strips that came with it!! They are nasty—The velcro sheds like crazy so I threw them away. Command strips are the way to go and because the back is nice and flat there is plenty of room for the strips.

t: love it! Plenty heavy duty enough
x: Use it in my garage....love it!  Plenty heavy duty enough.
This product is exactly what I wanted: Lightweight, easy to clean, and just big enough to fit on my desktop.

all their stuff is greatly priced and decent quality

This...for <7!! is amazing. However...it honestly is pretty cheaply made...the edging is nothing special...but for my purposes (pharmacology study oh boy), it's perfect. It's so lightweight (literally weighs less than a pound, by far) and erases cleanly w/ expo markers.

i've had ubrand markers in the past, and those were great to, btw! highly recommend!
Great portable white board that i use to do practice problems and such for college.

I volunteer with first-graders who are struggling to read and write. I can easily carry this whiteboard with me and they love writing on it! Much more fun for them than paper and pencil. They were so excited when I started using it with them. It's exactly what I wanted.

t: works as expected and comes at a reasonable price
x:
Needed something at my desk to keep notes. Does the trick, very lightweight.
Happy with this purchase.
Awesome white board to write thoughts on.  Easy to wipe off clean and start all over again with some new thoughts.  Light yo carry around with my books.

I had a game night and I brought to play with friends, the marker with eraser saved me some money and the adhesive doesn’t work that well, other than that.. it is very easy to clean and its so thin it makes it easy to carry and store
I didn’t mount it to a wall. Instead, I carry it in my messenger bag when I tutor. It’s the perfect size, and the pen is easily erased.

t: Easy to erase dry erase board, perfect size for my project
x: I wanted a dry erase board to keep by my computer and desk. This is the perfect size for me. I've also been pleased because it erases quite well. The marker works nicely. Its quite lightweight, easy to hold in your lap too while writing something.
I have no complaints about this whiteboard.  It's lightweight, easy to clean, and affordable.  I can't imagine anyone having an issue with this.
Great  for keeping my to do list in front of me in my home office. Light weight and sits right on my office desk.

Lightweight, fits my space very well. Arrived with a minor dent which is unnoticeable when the white board is hung up. I like the little magnetic pushpin section and the eraser on the dry erase marker is very useful.

t: The board itself is fine. The backing is cardboard
x:
The board itself is fine. The backing is cardboard, so I don't think this would be a good choice for heavy use, but it suits my residential application just fine. The tape that was included for hanging was worse than useless. It fell down in the middle of the first night. Nothing was damaged, but I needed to get new double sided tape.

Overall, well worth the price.

t: Nice and bright,  easy handling,  good for school kids.
x: Nice White board,  less in weight,  easy handling. Good for kids for school work.
It's weight required more magnets than provided.
Very ease to use , lightweight , and has a lot of board space . Very handy .
The whiteboard is great, it does its job. The marker is fine and erases easily. The strips used to attach it to the wall are crap and I would recommend you also buy those heavy duty command strips.

You need a white board? Do you need wall size or clip-board size? This one is about 1.5 times bigger than a clipboard (wider) and fits nicely in your hand or at your desk or on your wall. The velcro adhesive system was a little weird but if you apply it right and give it time to settle, you'll be able to take the whiteboard off and have the velcro stick around. It's nice because it's easy to hang anywhere (once). It's nice to carry it around or to lay it on my desk to jot notes/plans. If you need a whiteboard, and you don't need a big one, this one is fine. Get it.

I ordered this item thinking it came with magnetic strips so I could put on my refrigerator. Nope. It comes with Velcro strips. I now have to buy magnetic strips separately just to use it the way I originally intended. Other than that, product is light weight, comes with one small magnet that attaches to the dry erase board, and a dry erase pen.
Great price and love the size. Easy to carry around in the office.

This has worked wonderful for limited use. I've had it over 2½ years. I only use the pen that came with it. I did buy a different eraser.
If you're looking for a board for heavy use, or with color pens, ya gotta spend more money.

I bought this product to put onto the refrigerator for messages. Unfortunately, the product is very poorly made and the adhesive does not stick to the refrigerator. It cannot even hold its own weight. Overall, not impressed.

Perfect size for my son. His teacher requested that we get one for online learning so when they showed their work during live sessions it would be easier to see. Only issue is that the product has an indentation across a good portion of the dry erase board. It was sent in one of those bubble wrap envelopes and something heavy was most likely set on top of my package.
I love the size and the weight. I use it for online teaching and use magnetic figures that stick perfectly. Great product!

My daughter(4years) is learning to write, which is how my husband came up with the idea of purchasing a white board for her for the ease of writing on it, & basically learning.
The white board came with a (black)dry erase pen & four velcro stickers.
Undoubtedly, its light weight, very handy and easy to carry, oftentimes, my daughter keeps the board in her lap & keep writing or painting. The dry erase pen accompanied with the board has a tiny duster/eraser on top.
Moreover, the board is around 13 inch tall & 11 inch wide. Im glad we bought this product, m sure its gonna be equally helpful for parents/teachers/students/artists literally anyone.
This board is the perfect size, the eraser on the marker does start to smear after a lot of wear but is easily replaceable. Sturdy enough to use as a lap board but not heavy at all.
Just the right size it's lightweight, it does what I need it to do.
Small board / easy to carry around and use

For the price, I expected nothing more. I needed a small white board to carry around with me for school, so I do not know about how it hangs. The included marker writes fine, but it will leave black smudges if you use its eraser. The plastic border around it does feel flimsy. But, for six bucks, all of these are nothing major and can be easily overlooked. I've been carrying it around with me and have no problems with its trim.

Practical size of board to carry around, and easy wiping after writing.. however..After using the board once, the market holder broke and detached from frame..
marker ink depleted after a few writings.

t: Does not stick on wall or fridge
x: The wall mounts do not hold up at all. The board seems to be too heavy for the sticky part of the mount. Have not been able to keep it up. Waste

t: Small, cheap whiteboard but doesn't mount well
x: While I haven't used it yet, I assume the whiteboard itself will work as expected. My problem is the board is warped so much that the adhesive strips barely make contact with the wall, and it kept falling down until I finally took it down. If you're looking for a small whiteboard to carry around in an office to make diagrams or lists, this will probably work. If you're planning to mount it like I was, it may not serve that purpose as well.
Sturdy. Nice size with secure/non-velcro pen holder. Magnet grip. I take a picture instead of carrying a paper list.

t: Great little magnetic dry erase, for the cost.
x:
There's not much to this little board, a dry erase surface with something lightly magnetic, backed by cardboard in a cheap plastic frame.
It comes with adhesive strips and magnets to stick onto the back should you want it permanently affixed to a wall or magnetically hung on your refrigerator. As well as some nice dry erase markers, and a small magnet (that came apart within hours of first use).
The dry erase works fine so far and the magnetic aspect works well enough for our purposes. We don't plan to affix the board to anything, so I can't speak to that.
For the price, it serves its purpose and we're happy with it, but I don't know if it would stand up to long-term heavy usage. It doesn't seem to be terribly sturdy or durable.

This is just what I needed. I needed to get a larger whiteboard for an online class and this was the perfect size. It is super easy to erase and does not leave behind marks of the whiteboard marker. I clean it occasionally with whiteboard cleaner to keep it looking new. The marker that comes with the board is very nice as well. I use this as a portable whiteboard so I can not comment on how good the mounting would be.
Heavy duty.  It's good product.

This has worked for a daily to do list. It doesn’t clean very well sometimes and the marker smudges and smears when erasing, but it wipes off with a wet wipe decently. It hasn’t permanently stained or anything after some months of use. I don’t have it mounted as I didn’t have confidence it would stay but I also like to carry it room to room when cleaning.
My 5 years old son uses it to practice math and writing on it. It is very helpful. It is not heavy so he can take it anywhere and use it.

t: Good White Board --- Supply your own Markers
x: I purchased this White Board to better track work projects -- I needed something that was large enough to track multiple projects with numerous sub-steps but still portable. This board was perfect.  I would recommend a better marker -- it is a little hard to write clearly and the eraser just doesn't cut it. The magnetic portion is simply some tape, I wish it was built into the white board itself. Still for the price the White Board perfectly fit the bill.

Needed this super quick due to school being online this year. It light weight but not flimsy. Comes with pen (which has eraser on it) and a magnet as well. Decent for the price and easy for my 6 year old to handle and show his work to the teacher on video calls.

t: but it does the trick just fine for taking notes that have to be cleared out ...
x:
This is an exact copy of what I bought from Big Lots for about the same price around two years ago. It's a white board with some metal under it so you can stick magnetic things to it. Not much more needs to be said. The surface is a little bit difficult to clear off completely, especially with weeks' worth of marker drying out and attempting to merge with the board, but it does the trick just fine for taking notes that have to be cleared out at the end of a call. If you just need a simple whiteboard for your desk or fridge, go for it. It's not too expensive, and it's a great choice for just quick notes. Maybe there are $150 whiteboards out there, but they won't deliver much better than this. You won't, however, use the included magnet. I promise. It's incredibly weak, and you'd do better with some kind of rare-earth magnet, possibly some spheres that are small enough to carry a lot of them.

It's worth the price, but don't expect a miracle. It does its job perfectly fine, but the whiteboard paint comes off pretty easily with any metallic objects like, say, magnets.

t: Got these as gifts for my senior students!
x: I got 10 of these plus 10 thin marker packs for my seniors who just graduated. These are small enough to go on carry-on bags. That was important because some of our students are going out of state and abroad to school next year. They loved this as a gift for their new dorm rooms!

t: Great size to use for teaching
x: I'm a homeschooling mom going through a spelling curriculum (All About Spelling) with my son. I wanted a heavy duty but light white board so we both can spell out words. This one fits the bill, it's just the right size and the marker works well. The eraser on the pen is small and doesn't work well so you'll definitely want to use a better eraser, otherwise this board works well! We haven't tried mounting it, we just hold it.
